title: Attempting to change character portrait on state change and it feels impossible.

posts.author: Karadox
posts.body:
I do apologize as i am brand-new to this site apart from the occasional visit for a solution to my problem.
But im attempting to make a system that auto updates a characters portrait when they receive a state. In my use case it is when they 'die'. Figured out quickly that it can't be done in the default engine and i found
this
Yanfly tip which is exactly what im looking for but i cant get it working. Am i doing something wrong or am i cooked.
I would greatly appreciate any/all help

The first time i tried was running a parallel common event in a battle

parallel common events do not run in battle without a plugin to enable it actually.
Karadox said:
I set the span to moment and made it active when the first party member is at or below 100% Hp.
Click to expand...
parallel event? or troop event? is a troop event calling the common event? common events do not have spans, and judging the size of the contents area what you haven isnt a troop event.
Karadox said:
I have attatched a pdf below that shows the code that im running in the note tag of the state that gets applied when a character is KO'd. Sorry for any confusion
Click to expand...
if you click the toolbar at the top of the text area, theres an option for code. theres no need to share it as a pdf. use that in the future
you have 8 actors and theyre sharing sprite sheets? in my opinion, it would be easier to manage it by giving each actor their own sprite sheets named with the actor's name. then instead of using all of those else-if statements for each actor, you can change it to use the file that has the actor's name and use the correct index for for the state.
The more you interact with yanfly's "custom" notetags, the more it becomes a better idea to familiarize yourself with javascript as well as
MV's script calls
. if you need an example of what i described, you can ask for it

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Karadox said:
The first time i tried was running a parallel common event in a battle. I set the span to moment and made it active when the first party member is at or below 100% Hp.
Click to expand...
You seem to be mixing up some terminology. You can't run parallel common events in battle. Troop events are not common events, and they're not parallel.
When posting screenshots of events, please don't crop off all the settings - you may want to read through the pinned rules thread for this section, which has good advice on how to get good help:
Rules - RPG MAKER MV SUPPORT RULES
RPG MAKER MV SUPPORT RULES (Last Update: November 21st, 2023)  All General Forum Rules apply. Please review and understand these before making a post in this section.   If your issue relates directly to a plugin, please use the JavaScript/Plugin Support section or the plugin's dedicated thread...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Karadox said:
I have attatched a pdf below that shows the code that im running in the note tag of the state that gets applied when a character is KO'd.
Click to expand...
Why? Just paste it into your post - who wants to download a separate file and open it up in another window for that?
That's horrible overkill for what you want to do. But it also doesn't look like you're
doing
anything. You're just setting them to the default faces, only in a different order than they are by default. You don't have some specific dead face image you want to use?
Like, your event up there shows you changing them to the first face of Actor0, but that's not in your code anyplace.
There's no reason for you to be changing the battlers and character sprites, and no reason for all of those extraneous variables.
The code to do what you want should be pretty short - what's the correspondence between the actor ID and their index in the Actor0 face sheet? We can't see from your event what the actor IDs for each name are.
